comment: Blood Sun step 5 (design §9.1): life 4 -- the same board as the life-3 fixture. Grim Tutor fetches the bottom Bolt (the searched target), we lose 3 (4 -> 1, life loss not damage), and the Bolt kills the opponent at 3 on this turn with the Mountain. d3, budget 100. Step 6c: run with the USER target restriction OFF (MTG_BLOODSUN_USER_PRUNE=0) -- Lightning Bolt is not a USER tutor target; this fixture pins the card mechanics (bloodsun_prune_grim_bolt_not_target_* is the restricted twin).
